items.description: Boise State head coach Spencer Danielson said this week's opponent, Western Michigan, is 'undefeated' after WMU's controversial Week 1 loss at Michigan.

items.headline: Buckley, Lowry, and Mataele each score TDs for Western Michigan in 28-21 win over Rice
items.description: — Jalen Buckley, Ofa Mataele, and Brock Lowry each scored rushing touchdowns as Western Michigan beat Rice 28-21 on Saturday.

items.headline: FBS oversight committee says it can't overturn WMU's loss
items.description: The NCAA's FBS oversight committee acknowledged that replay protocols were not properly followed at the end of Western Michigan's controversial loss to Michigan in Week 1 but said it does not have the authority to overturn the result of the game.
